title: 第1439章 天诛杀帝君第1438章 躁脾气
slug: 被逐出宗门后师尊师姐后悔终生
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：被逐出宗门后，师尊师姐后悔终生第1439章天诛杀帝君（..la）“既然如此，那就把她复活吧。”
瓶子对着周通说道，仿佛理所当然。
“你跟我很熟吗？”
周通嘴角一咧，这家伙简直比镜子还要张狂。
有没有搞清楚，到底谁是老大啊？
“你过来…”
瓶子飞身而起，抵住了周通的后背，将他推到了远处。
这般动作，充满了即视感。
周通丝毫都不怀疑，如果这家伙拥有人形的话，此刻必然已经跟他勾肩搭背了。
“咱们之间，还用分谁是谁吗？”
瓶子小声说道，甚至还用法力构筑了一层屏障，唯恐让青灵听见。
“嘶…还是分清楚的一点好。”
周通脸皮抽搐，倒吸凉气，这家伙好像忘记了在正面世界与他大打出手的场景。
究竟是装糊涂，还是开智了，竟让他嗅到了几分滚刀肉的味道。
他精神力微微一扫，只见青灵透过屏障，侧耳倾听状，什么都没听到之后依旧不忘踮起脚，想要看清两人究竟在干什么。
这个动作，让他忍不住心头一震。
这黑瓶子，该不会是要脸了吧，唯恐在青灵面前丢了面子。
这不扯的吗！
一件兵器而已，还怕丢份儿，竟然衍生出了脸面的概念！
“咳！

！”
意识深处，传来了镜子的咳嗽声，让周通恍然惊觉，兵器是真的会要脸的，而且自尊心极高，有的甚至还会泡妞呢！
当他重新审视瓶子的时候，很快就又没了兴致。
麻麻赖赖坑坑洼洼的，脾气还臭，等级又低，凭什么要让他配合演戏？
甚至更无耻的是，这家伙想要消费，还要让自己买单，不就是救个人吗，以准帝兵的本源精华，生骨还灵不过小道而已！
更何况青灵的精神灵魂都保留了下来，没有受到分毫损伤，难度可以说是更减一等！
“咳…你不是本来就想救人吗，怎么突然就变卦了？”
瓶子语气急促地说道，显然是急了。
“我改变了主意不行吗，救人多累啊，我都救了一辈子的人了，还不能享受享受？”
“你知道的，救人一命胜造七级浮屠，这可是大功德…”
周通听了想笑，瓶子作为一个说客是蹩脚的。
作为一件兵器，是搞笑的！
死在他手下的生灵难以计数，而他救过的人约等于没有，此刻竟然说救人一命胜造七级浮屠。
如果不是青灵对他极为重要，他绝对不会这么上心。
这功德给你要不要！
“想要救她的话，你自己出手不就行了？”
此话一出，瓶子陷入了沉默。
这般姿态，倒让周通微微一愣。
“你该不会做不到吧，不是吧，你可是准帝兵啊！”
就在这时，镜子的声音再次传来。

“他的神髓受到了严重的损伤，只有攻伐之能，而无挽救之力，显然是当年的意外过于恐怖！
不过话说回来，受创如此之深，竟然还能保持住准帝兵的水准，可见其巅峰时期之强大！”
如此评价，让周通都忍不住感到惊奇。
毕竟在镜子的口中，那洪荒混沌塔都只不过是路边一条。

Bo Bo said to Zhou Tong as if it was natural.
"Are you familiar with me?"
Zhou Tong grinned, this guy was even more arrogant than a mirror.
Have you figured out who is the boss?
"Come here..."
The bottle flew up and pressed against Zhou Tong's back, pushing him far away.
This kind of action is full of a sense of immediacy.
Zhou Tong had no doubt that if this guy had a human form, he would be hooking up with him at this moment.
"Do we still need to distinguish who is who among us?"
Bottle whispered, and even used mana to build a barrier, lest Qing Ling hear it.
"Hiss...it's better to distinguish clearly."
Zhou Tong's face twitched and he gasped. This guy seemed to have forgotten the scene of fighting him in the frontal world.
Whether he was pretending to be confused or being wise, he actually smelled a bit of meat on a hob.
With a slight sweep of his mental energy, he saw Qing Ling peeking through the barrier, listening intently. Even after hearing nothing, he still stood on tiptoe, trying to see clearly what the two of them were doing.
This action made him feel shocked.
This black bottle must be shameless, for fear of losing face in front of Qing Ling.
Isn’t this nonsense!
It’s just a weapon, but for fear of losing one’s status, the concept of face is derived from it!
"Ahem!
! "
Deep in his consciousness, the sound of Mirror's coughing came, and Zhou Tong suddenly realized that weapons are really capable of showing off, and they have extremely high self-esteem, and some even pick up girls!
When he looked at the bottle again, he quickly lost interest again.
Mama Lailai is a mess, has a bad temper, and is of low rank. Why should he be allowed to cooperate in acting?
What's even more shameless is that this guy wants to consume, but he has to pay for it. Isn't it just to save someone? With the essence of the quasi-emperor's soldiers, the raw bones and souls are nothing more than a trail!
What's more, Qing Ling's spirit and soul have been preserved without any damage, and the difficulty can be said to be even lower!
"Ahem... didn't you originally want to save people? Why did you suddenly change your mind?"
Bottle said in a hurried tone, obviously anxious.
"Can't I change my mind? It's so tiring to save people. I've saved people all my life, why can't I enjoy it?"
"You know, saving one life is better than building a seven-level pagoda. This is a great merit..."
Zhou Tong wanted to laugh after hearing this. Ping Bo was terrible as a lobbyist.
As a weapon, it’s hilarious!
Countless lives have died under his hands, and he has saved almost no people. At this moment, he actually said that saving one life is better than building a seven-level pagoda.
If Qing Ling wasn't extremely important to him, he would never be so concerned about it.
Do you want this merit?
"If you want to save her, don't you just do it yourself?"
As soon as these words came out, Bottle fell into silence.
This gesture made Zhou Tong slightly stunned.
"You can't do it, can't you? You are a quasi-emperor soldier!"
At this moment, the voice of the mirror came again.
"His marrow has been severely damaged. He can only attack but not save. It is obviously because the accident that year was too terrible!
But having said that, he was still able to maintain the level of a quasi-imperial soldier despite being so deeply wounded, which shows how powerful he was at his peak! "
Such comments made Zhou Tong unable to help but feel surprised.
After all, according to Mirror, the Primordial Chaos Tower is just a roadside road.
